It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 14, 2020 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the provincial capital city of [[Tagbilaran]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Alburquerque, Bohol|Alburquerque]], [[Antequera, Bohol|Antequera]], [[Baclayon]], [[Balilihan]], [[Calape, Bohol|Calape]], [[Catigbian]], [[Corella, Bohol|Corella]], [[Cortes, Bohol|Cortes]], [[Dauis, Bohol|Dauis]], [[Loon, Bohol|Loon]], [[Maribojoc]], [[Panglao, Bohol|Panglao]], [[Sikatuna, Bohol|Sikatuna]] and [[Tubigon]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[John Geesnell Yap|John Geesnell “Baba” Yap]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP).{{cite web |title= |url= |accessdate= |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
